newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan auctions 6-month bonds at 15.3594 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan auctions 6-month bonds at 15.3594 pct.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Tuesday it had auctioned six-month federal investment bonds worth a total of 5.544 billion rupees at a weighted average annual yield of 15.3594 percent.
The auction will be settled on Thursday. The bank had set a pre-auction target of 12 billion rupees but received bids worth a total of 5.544 billion rupees, all of which were accepted.
At the last auction on October 22, it accepted bids worth 5.165 billion rupees at a weighted average yield of 14.27106 percent, against a pre-auction target of 13.065 billion rupees.
